steps.what: Define chemical-process model boundaries, species, thermodynamic assumptions and operating cases; verify and enter actual source values
Develop computer models of chemical processes by assembling flowsheets, stream units and unit-operation equations in the process-simulation category of {OTHER}
Test mass and energy closure, limiting cases, convergence and sensitivity; compare against independent process evidence and check the final model snapshot and limitations
Save the exact checked model snapshot and limitations in {DOCS}

tasks.design: Test native stream templates, unit conversion and validated unit-operation libraries in the process-simulation category of {OTHER}. Reuse setup structure while the engineer still selects physical assumptions, validates every operating case and saves the checked model version with its limits.
tasks.previous_blocker: Recreating stream structure and repeated unit-operation setup takes engineering time.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reusable model components can reduce that setup without replacing thermodynamic judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Convergence does not establish correct chemistry, phase behaviour or plant validity.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether assumptions and validation evidence justify using the model.

ambition.what: Compare an additional explicitly bounded operating case when setup time genuinely falls.

tasks.altitude: More attention to sensitivity and model limits, with unchanged engineering sign-off.

reach.learn: Distinguish measured plant behaviour from model assumptions.

evidence.claim: Process simulators can reuse unit-operation structures and units; engineering validation remains necessary.

assumptions: Boundary is offline model development, not plant control or physical experiments. No runtime or other-role saving is credited.

The engineer produces species, stream rates with units, composition, temperature, pressure, property-method choice and case boundaries in s1. Operating staff or existing records supply observed values and provenance; engineering checking and manual entry are counted in s1. Missing properties or ambiguous units require manual investigation, not guessed defaults.

Native reuse is tested before custom generation. Shares are an illustrative repeated-model scenario, not measured baselines. s3 checks the completed final snapshot; any model edit invalidates the save approval.
unknowns: Which native components are already used
research_questions: Which repeated setup fields can be reused without concealing changed physical assumptions?

already_counted.description: Model setup review and scientific validation remain in s2-s3.

incremental.description: Revalidate reusable components after property-library or process changes.

approvals.approved_version: Final model, case inputs and limitations checked in s3; any edit requires revalidation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A repeated setup gives 35 times 20 percent, or 7 gross hours, less 2 upkeep for 5 net. Already configured native libraries or novel chemistry yield zero benefit. Scientific validation and saving are retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct work on absorption, evaporation and electromagnetic equipment

steps.what: Read the equipment work package, process constraints and current construction or operating condition before directing activities
Direct activities of workers operating, constructing or improving absorption, evaporation or electromagnetic equipment; discuss hazards and inspect progress with the workers
Write and check the actual equipment instructions and unresolved constraints in the existing {PROJECT} work item
Post the exact checked instruction update to the existing {PROJECT} work item

tasks.design: Keep the existing work-package review, direct equipment supervision and {PROJECT} instruction update. No demonstrated repeated entry or deterministic decision is removed after separating the live direction from its written record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Direction depends on actual operating or construction conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing records support the work, but no additional saving mechanism is established.
tasks.still_hard: Changing hazards, installation details and worker questions require responsible engineering direction.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer relates physical equipment behaviour to the workers' immediate decisions.

ambition.what: No change in engineering or operating authority.

tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in this direction task.

reach.learn: Translate physical constraints into safe equipment instructions.

evidence.claim: Equipment direction requires interpretation of actual operating and construction conditions.

assumptions: Boundary is the engineer's direction and ordinary work-item instructions, not workers' physical execution, plant commands or formal release. Worker time earns no saving.

The work package is produced by the responsible engineering team and includes equipment identity, approved scope, constraints and current status. The engineer obtains actual progress in s2 and writes actual instructions in s3; missing data are clarified manually. No transcription pipeline or free structured inputs are assumed.

The scenario uses an existing native work item, with no duplicate instruction entry established. Shares are illustrative, not measured. The ordinary s3 wording check occurs after the final instruction exists and binds the exact update; edits require rechecking.
No new tool or configuration is proposed, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Whether written instructions are required in the current work item
Whether any real duplicate capture occurs
research_questions: Is there repeated record work beyond the existing direct instruction entry?

already_counted.description: Written instruction preparation and normal final checking remain in s3.

incremental.description: No new tool or procedure; zero additional upkeep.

approvals.approved_version: Actual instruction update checked in s3; any edit voids the check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live direction, package review and actual written instructions are split and all retained. Native record entry already exists; no duplicated work or new tool benefit is established.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Model setup can shrink while physical process judgement and equipment direction retain their authority.
reach: Understand operator and mechanic constraints during process changes.
role.ambitious_version: An engineer who compares bounded process alternatives while keeping models and actual equipment conditions distinct.
